group_context: Six standalone satirical Civil War Confederate military costume archetypes. No historical likeness, canonical deck mapping or inferred pair/trio relations.

figuren.name: General Fernlage

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: male-read pompous general. Broad heavy pear-shaped blob, heavy folded lids, weary superior side-eye, one pushed-out crooked lower lip, a single irregular lower tooth. Large battered grey campaign hat with a modest gold cord, small grey shoulder tabs with brass stars. Holds ONE short brass spyglass pressed low against his own belly, viewing nobody through it. He appears affronted that the distant situation has failed to improve. Standing frontally, body substantial.

figuren.name: Feldwebelin Säbelmut

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: female-read cavalry sergeant. Tall hooked bean silhouette, subtle lashes and single compact clay side curl, grey kepi tipped sideways, yellow cuff detail and small simple chevron cloth badge. Delighted reckless confidence, eyes look to side with one lid lifted high, broad lopsided toothy smile, mouth relatively shallow. Holds ONE short thick curved cavalry saber upright beside her own blob, entire blade contained in cell; hilt visibly gripped. No raised arm crossing cell.

figuren.name: Gefreiter Zündverzug

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: male-read nervous infantry private. Round dumpling with two blunt crown lobes beside a crumpled butternut cap. Wide white eyes fixed DOWN at his weapon, lips tightly squeezed around a disobedient upper tooth, little trembling lower lip; comic dread, no open round shouting mouth. Hugs ONE short cartoon percussion musket upright, simple wood stock, steel single barrel, visible little hammer, ramrod tucked against stock. Few straps, tiny canteen at side. Complete self-contained silhouette.

figuren.name: Hauptmann Kugelpflicht

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: male-read artillery captain. Very wide low bean, one long hooked goo lobe at top, battered grey kepi, orange-yellow collar tab. Deeply exhausted half-lidded downward eyes, compressed sideways grimace showing three unequal teeth, huge heavy lower lip. Holds ONE smooth black cannonball in one hand and ONE short fat wooden rammer with rounded swab head in the other, both low beside body. The ball is absurdly treated as a delicate responsibility. No cannon, floor or crouch.

figuren.name: Leutnantin Vorratsrecht

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: female-read quartermaster lieutenant. Compact near-square soft lobed blob, two short crown bumps, subtle lashes, tiny grey kepi and small brass collar bars, butternut shoulder cloth. Narrow suspicious gaze looking upward, one lifted skeptical brow, pursed asymmetric tiny mouth with one offset tooth. Hugs ONE dented rectangular tin ration box shut against her belly, ONE oversized brass key hooked over its latch, clear goo hands. Gleefully possessive officious attitude, not a repeated angry grin. No letters on tin.

figuren.name: Korporal Taktbruch

bild.rect_convention: left,top,right,bottom; right/bottom exclusive; use explicit bounds, not fixed512 crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: male-read drummer corporal. Top-heavy teardrop with offset droplet lobes, oversized drooping grey forage cap and small brass buttons. Ecstatic full-body enthusiasm at peak beat, mismatched wide white eyes glancing up, cheek compressed by very broad irregular laughing mouth, only four uneven teeth. Small cream rope-tension drum strapped against lower blob, two thick wooden beaters held angled inward within own cell. No flying punctuation, tongue or motion lines.
